latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – generates academically rigorous methodology chapters/sections in Chinese for theses and papers.

- Determines research type (quantitative, qualitative, mixed methods, literature review, or intervention design) based on user-provided details.
- Drafts complete Chinese "第三章 研究方法/研究设计" sections, including all required subheadings and content.
- Handles missing information with clear Chinese placeholders.
- Uses detailed academic templates and local methodology writing standards.
- Provides a revision checklist after the draft for user review.
